title: Reconcile experiment arms between the manifest and D20
body:
Outcome: the experiment manifest and ADR 0014 D20 name the same arms (manifest says A/B/C/R, D20 says A/B/S) before any proof result is interpreted; a changed decision goes to the operator first.
Source: operator RSS intake .krn/runs/delivery-loop/session-continuity/rss-intake/2026-11-01.md item "Repo divergence".
